name: Lithium-Ion batteries used in Hewlett-Packard and Compaq notebook computers
description: HP Recalls Notebook Computer Batteries Due to Fire Hazard
report_text: CPSC recall 09221 published 2009-05-14. Title: HP Recalls Notebook Computer Batteries Due to Fire Hazard Product: Lithium-Ion batteries used in Hewlett-Packard and Compaq notebook computers Hazard: The recalled lithium-ion batteries can overheat, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Incidents/Injuries: The firm and CPSC are aware of two reports of batteries that overheated and ruptured, resulting in flames/fire that caused minor property damage. No injuries have been reported. Remedy: Consumers should immediately remove the recalled battery from their notebook computer and contact HP to determine if their battery is included in the recall and to request a free replacement battery. After removing the recalled battery from their notebook computer, consumers may use the AC adapter to power the computer until a replacement battery arrives. Source: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2009/HP-Recalls-Notebook-Computer-Batteries-Due-to-Fire-Hazard

name: Personal computers
description: Sony Recalls VAIO Flip PC Laptops Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
report_text: CPSC recall 14220 published 2014-07-01. Title: Sony Recalls VAIO Flip PC Laptops Due to Fire and Burn Hazards Product: Personal computers Hazard: The computers' lithium-ion batteries can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Incidents/Injuries: Sony is aware of four incidents, which occurred in Asia, of computers overheating, resulting in units smoking, catching on fire and melting. No injuries have been reported. Remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled personal computers, shut it down and unplug it; and contact Sony for instructions on how to arrange for an inspection free of charge to the consumer and a free repair or full refund of the computer's purchase price. Incidents/Injuries: None reported. description: PC Notebook Computer Batteries Recalled Due to Fire and Burn Hazard
report_text: CPSC recall 09035 published 2008-10-30. Title: PC Notebook Computer Batteries Recalled Due to Fire and Burn Hazard Product: Lithium-Ion Batteries used in Hewlett-Packard, Toshiba and Dell Notebook Computers Hazard: These lithium-ion batteries can overheat, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Incidents/Injuries: There have been 19 reports of the batteries overheating, including 17 reports of flames/fire (10 resulting in minor property damage). Two consumers experienced minor burns. report_text: CPSC recall 25190 published 2025-03-20. report_text: CPSC recall 26090 published 2025-11-13. Title: Belkin Recalls Portable Power Banks and Wireless Charging Stands Due to Fire and Burn Hazards Product: Portable Power Banks and Wireless Charging Stands Hazard: The lithium-ion battery in the power banks and charging stands can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Incidents/Injuries: The firm has received one report of a fire incident in the U.S. (and 15 reports internationally). Two minor burn injuries and property damage totaling $37,765 have been reported outside of the U.S. Remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled power banks and charging stands and contact Belkin to receive a full refund or store credit. Consumers should submit photos showing the front and back of the product with their recall submission form. Consumers can receive a full refund for the amount on the purchase receipt, if provided. If no receipt is provided, consumers can receive the average sales price for the model. Alternatively, consumers can choose to receive a Belkin store credit worth 20 percent more than the average sales price of the model. Note: Do not throw this recalled lithium-ion battery or device in the trash, the general recycling stream (e.g., street-level or curbside recycling bins), or used battery recycling boxes found at various retail and home improvement stores. Recalled lithium-ion batteries must be disposed of differently than other batteries, because they present a greater risk of fire. Your municipal household hazardous waste (HHW) collection center may accept this recalled lithium-ion battery or device for disposal. Before taking your battery or device to a HHW collection center, contact that office ahead of time and ask whether it accepts recalled lithium-ion batteries. If it does not, contact your municipality for further guidance. name: Ryobi Router Table Throat Plates
description: One World Technologies Recalls Throat Plates Sold with Ryobi Router Tables Due to Laceration Hazard
report_text: CPSC recall 07120 published 2007-03-06. Title: One World Technologies Recalls Throat Plates Sold with Ryobi Router Tables Due to Laceration Hazard Product: Ryobi Router Table Throat Plates Hazard: The throat plates do not securely snap into the router's table top bit opening. The throat plate can come loose during operation and be ejected from the table top, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Incidents/Injuries: One World Technologies has received three reports of throat plates coming loose during use. Two consumers were struck on the nose by the throat plate and received a minor cut and bruising. Remedy: Consumers should immediately check their router tables to ensure that the throat plates securely snap into the router bit opening. If any throat plates do not securely snap into the table top, consumers should stop using the router table immediately and contact One Word Technologies for a free replacement set of throat plates. Source: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2007/One-World-Technologies-Recalls-Throat-Plates-Sold-with-Ryobi-Router-Tables-Due-to-Laceration-Hazard

name: Rechargeable batteries used in 15-inch Apple PowerBook G4 computers
description: CPSC, Apple Announce Recall of PowerBook Computer Batteries
report_text: CPSC recall 04201 published 2004-08-19. Title: CPSC, Apple Announce Recall of PowerBook Computer Batteries Product: Rechargeable batteries used in 15-inch Apple PowerBook G4 computers Hazard: An internal short can cause the battery cells to overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Incidents/Injuries: Apple has received four reports of batteries overheating, though no injuries have been reported. Remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled batteries immediately and contact Apple to arrange for a replacement battery, free of charge. Source: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2004/CPSC-Apple-Announce-Recall-of-PowerBook-Computer-Batteries-

name: HP and Compaq Notebook Computer Battery Packs
description: CPSC, Hewlett-Packard Company Announce Recall of Notebook Computer Batteries
report_text: CPSC recall 06007 published 2005-10-14. Title: CPSC, Hewlett-Packard Company Announce Recall of Notebook Computer Batteries Product: HP and Compaq Notebook Computer Battery Packs Hazard: An internal short can cause the battery cells to overheat and melt or char the plastic case, posing a burn and fire hazard. Incidents/Injuries: HP has received 16 reports of batteries overheating, including four in the U.S. No injuries have been reported. Four cases of minor property damage were reported, including one in the U.S. Remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled batteries immediately and contact HP to arrange for a free replacement battery, by visiting the Battery Replacement program Web site or by calling HP. After removing the recalled battery for their notebook computer, consumers should plug in the AC adapter to power the notebook until a replacement battery arrives. Source: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2006/CPSC-Hewlett-Packard-Company-Announce-Recall-of-Notebook-Computer-Batteries

name: SCUBA Diving Computers
description: CPSC, Head USA Inc. Announce Recall of SCUBA Diving Computers
report_text: CPSC recall 05118 published 2005-02-22. Title: CPSC, Head USA Inc. Announce Recall of SCUBA Diving Computers Product: SCUBA Diving Computers Hazard: The dive computers were improperly calibrated, resulting in incorrect calculations. Diving with an improperly calibrated dive computer can provide inaccurate "No Decompression (no stop) Time," "Decompression Time," "Desaturation Time" and "No Fly Time." This could result in divers suffering serious injuries, including decompression sickness. Incidents/Injuries: Head USA received one report of a computer malfunction. No injuries were reported. Remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these recalled diving computers and return the computers to an authorized Dacor dealer for a free repair. Source: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2005/CPSC-Head-USA-Inc-Announce-Recall-of-SCUBA-Diving-Computers-

name: ThinkPad notebook computer battery packs
description: Lenovo Recalls Battery Packs for ThinkPad Notebook Computers Due to Fire Hazard
report_text: CPSC recall 14142 published 2014-03-27. Title: Lenovo Recalls Battery Packs for ThinkPad Notebook Computers Due to Fire Hazard Product: ThinkPad notebook computer battery packs Hazard: The battery packs can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Incidents/Injuries: Lenovo has received two reports of the battery packs overheating, resulting in damage to the computer, battery pack and nearby property. No injuries have been reported. Remedy: Consumers should immediately turn off their ThinkPad notebook computer, remove the battery pack and contact Lenovo for a free replacement battery pack. Consumers can continue to use their ThinkPad notebook without the battery pack by plugging in the AC adapter and power cord. Source: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2014/Lenovo-Recalls-Battery-Packs-for-ThinkPad-Notebook-Computers

report_text: CPSC recall 01010 published 2000-10-12. Title: CPSC, DeWALT® Industrial Tool Co. Consumers should contact Polycom Inc. for information on receiving a free replacement battery. name: Samsung Galaxy Note7 smartphones
description: Samsung Expands Recall of Galaxy Note7 Smartphones Based on Additional Incidents with Replacement Phones; Serious Fire and Burn Hazards
report_text: CPSC recall 17011 published 2016-10-13. Title: Samsung Expands Recall of Galaxy Note7 Smartphones Based on Additional Incidents with Replacement Phones; Serious Fire and Burn Hazards Product: Samsung Galaxy Note7 smartphones Hazard: The lithium-ion battery in the Galaxy Note7 smartphones can overheat and catch fire, posing serious fire and burn hazard to consumers. Incidents/Injuries: Samsung has received 96 reports of batteries in Note7 phones overheating in the U.S., including 23 new reports since the September 15 recall announcement. Samsung has received 13 reports of burns and 47 reports of property damage associated with Note7 phones. Remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using and power down all Galaxy Note7 devices, including Note7 devices received as replacements in the previous recall. Contact the wireless carrier, retail outlet or Samsung.com where you purchased your device to receive a refund or free exchange for a new replacement device plus incentives. Consumers who purchased their phones from other sources should contact Samsung directly to receive a free remedy. Go to http://www.samsung.com and http://www.samsung.com/us/note7recall/ for more details. Source: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2017/Samsung-Expands-Recall-of-Galaxy-Note7-Smartphones-Based-on-Additional-Incidents-with-Replacement-Phones

name: Panasonic battery packs used in Toshiba laptop computers
description: Toshiba Recalls Laptop Computer Battery Packs Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
report_text: CPSC recall 16131 published 2016-03-30. Title: Toshiba Recalls Laptop Computer Battery Packs Due to Burn and Fire Hazards Product: Panasonic battery packs used in Toshiba laptop computers Hazard: The lithium-ion battery packs can overheat, posing burn and fire hazards to consumers. Incidents/Injuries: The firm has received four reports of the battery packs overheating and melting. No injuries have been reported. Remedy: Consumers should immediately go to the firm's website and click on the battery pack utility link in the first shadowed box on the page. Consumers can also perform a manual check using the laptop and battery pack's model, part and serial numbers. If it is part of the recall, consumers should power off the laptop, remove the battery and follow the instructions to obtain a free replacement battery pack. Until a replacement battery pack is received, consumers should use the laptop by plugging into AC power only. Source: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2016/Toshiba-Recalls-Laptop-Computer-Battery-Packs

name: Belkin BoostCharge Pro Fast Wireless Charger Power Banks 10K

report_text: CPSC recall 25061 published 2024-12-05. Remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled power banks and contact Belkin to receive a full refund or store credit. Consumers will need to submit photos showing the front and back of the power bank with their recall submission form. Consumers should dispose of the lithium-ion battery in accordance with local and state regulations and not in household trash. name: Parents® Magazine Record-A-Voice Toy Cell Phones
description: Battat Inc. Recalls Parents Magazine Toy Cell Phones for Choking Hazard
report_text: CPSC recall 07178 published 2007-05-03. Title: Battat Inc. Recalls Parents Magazine Toy Cell Phones for Choking Hazard Product: Parents® Magazine Record-A-Voice Toy Cell Phones Hazard: The metal pin inside the hinge of the cell phone flip-top can fall out, posing a choking hazard to young children. Incidents/Injuries: The firm has received 54 reports of the metal pin falling out of the hinge. In two cases, consumers reported finding the pin inside a child's mouth, with one child receiving a cut in the mouth. Remedy: Consumers should take these toy cell phones away from young children immediately and contact Battat to receive a replacement product or refund. name: Manik and Apex-branded ATX Computer Power Supplies (PSU)
description: Apex Gaming PCs Recalls Manik and Apex-branded ATX Computer Power Supplies Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Electrical Shock and Electrocution Hazards
report_text: CPSC recall 26426 published 2026-04-16. Title: Apex Gaming PCs Recalls Manik and Apex-branded ATX Computer Power Supplies Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Electrical Shock and Electrocution Hazards Product: Manik and Apex-branded ATX Computer Power Supplies (PSU) Hazard: The units lack a permanent, on-product warning label identifying potential electrical shock and electrocution hazards, posing a risk of serious injury or death if the unit is opened or disassembled. Incidents/Injuries: None reported Remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled computer power supplies immediately and contact Apex Gaming PCs Inc. for a free repair in the form of one permanent, UL-recognized, heat-resistant adhesive safety label containing an ANSI-compliant "Danger/Warning" shock hazard and "No User-Serviceable Parts" label sticker to be mailed to the consumer via U.S. Mail. Consumers who are uncomfortable adding the UL-recognized safety label can request a free replacement unit. Replacement units will be sent free of charge, and the original unit must be returned using the same box and provided shipping label that is sent with the replacement unit. Consumers should not, under any circumstances, attempt to open, disassemble, or service the power supply unit. Source: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2026/Apex-Gaming-PCs-Recalls-Manik-and-Apex-branded-ATX-Computer-Power-Supplies-Due-to-Risk-of-Serious-Injury-or-Death-from-Electrical-Shock-and-Electrocution-Hazards

name: Batteries in refurbished cellphones

report_text: CPSC recall 17762 published 2017-08-16. Title: FedEx Supply Chain Recalls Cellphone Batteries That Could Lead to Fire and Burn Hazards (Recall Alert) Product: Batteries in refurbished cellphones Hazard: The cellphone battery can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Incidents/Injuries: FedEx Supply Chain has received one report of a counterfeit battery overheating. There have been no reports of injuries or property damage. Remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled battery and power down their smartphone. Consumers who own the recalled battery will receive by mail from FedEx Supply Chain a free, new replacement battery and a postage paid box to return the recalled cellphone battery. A green dot has been affixed to the replacement batteries. FedEx Supply Chain is directly contacting consumers. Source: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2017/FedEx-Supply-Chain-Recalls-Cellphone-Batteries-Recall-Alert

name: Cozy Coupe Computer Mouse sets
description: CPSC, KB Gear Announce Recall of Computer Mouse Sets
report_text: CPSC recall 02048 published 2001-11-28. Title: CPSC, KB Gear Announce Recall of Computer Mouse Sets Product: Cozy Coupe Computer Mouse sets Hazard: The mouse ball can separate from the mouse and pose a choking hazard to young children. Incidents/Injuries: CPSC received a report of a 2-year-old girl, who placed the mouse ball in her mouth. Her parents were able to take the ball away from the girl before she was injured. Remedy: The Cozy Coupe Computer Mouse was distributed by KB Gear under license from Little Tikes Co., of Hudson, Ohio. KB Gear liquidated and as of Nov. 1, 2001, is no longer in business. As a result, the company is unable to provide consumers with a remedy. To encourage consumers to destroy the computer mouse and as a gesture of goodwill, Little Tikes is offering an equivalent $10 Little Tikes toy to consumers who return the retaining ring from the bottom of the mouse. description: Fantasia Trading Recalls Anker Power Banks Due to Fire Hazard
report_text: CPSC recall 23147 published 2023-03-09. Title: Fantasia Trading Recalls Anker Power Banks Due to Fire Hazard Product: Anker 535 Power Banks (PowerCore 20k) Hazard: The lithium-ion batteries in the recalled power banks can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Incidents/Injuries: The firm has received 10 reports of incidents involving overheating, including one report of minor injuries. Remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled power banks and contact Fantasia Trading to receive a full refund as well as instructions for properly disposing of lithium-ion batteries according to local and state regulations. Fantasia Trading and its retailers are notifying all known purchasers directly. Source: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2023/Fantasia-Trading-Recalls-Anker-Power-Banks-Due-to-Fire-Hazard

name: Certain LG 830 "Spyder" Cell Phones

report_text: CPSC recall 09724 published 2009-02-27. Incidents/Injuries: The firm has received one report of a motorist in a disabled car who was able to dial 911, but the call was dropped because the network had difficulty establishing a GPS lock on the phone. report_text: CPSC recall 17109 published 2017-03-14. name: Toshiba Laptop AC Adapters
description: Dynabook Americas Recalls 15.5 Million Toshiba Laptop AC Adapters Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
report_text: CPSC recall 24122 published 2024-02-21. Title: Dynabook Americas Recalls 15.5 Million Toshiba Laptop AC Adapters Due to Burn and Fire Hazards Product: Toshiba Laptop AC Adapters Hazard: The laptop AC adapters can overheat and spark, posing burn and fire hazards. report_text: CPSC recall 04513 published 2003-11-18. name: iWALK Magnetic Wireless Power Banks

report_text: CPSC recall 25304 published 2025-05-29. report_text: CPSC recall 15016 published 2014-10-30. Incidents/Injuries: Two incidents reported the USB charger melting. No injuries or property damage were reported. Remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the charger and contact Tectron International to request a mailing label to return the merchandise. Mailing labels will be emailed to customers. name: Oceanic and AERIS Digital Dive Computers

name: ESR HaloLock Wireless Power Banks
description: ESR HaloLock Wireless Power Banks Recalled Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Distributed by Waymeet
report_text: CPSC recall 25437 published 2025-08-14. Title: ESR HaloLock Wireless Power Banks Recalled Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Distributed by Waymeet Product: ESR HaloLock Wireless Power Banks Hazard: The lithium-ion battery in the recalled power banks can overheat and ignite, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Incidents/Injuries: The firm has received nine reports of the lithium-ion battery catching fire and exploding, resulting in property damage of about $20,000. No injuries have been reported. Remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled power banks and contact Waymeet for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to send to support@esrtech.com their order number (not required) and a photo of the recalled power bank showing the model number with the word "Recalled" written on it in permanent marker. Consumers should dispose of the power banks in accordance with local and state hazardous waste disposal regulations. Note: Do not throw this recalled lithium-ion battery or device in the trash, the general recycling stream (e.g., street-level or curbside recycling bins), or used battery recycling boxes found at various retail and home improvement stores. Recalled lithium-ion batteries must be disposed of differently than other batteries, because they present a greater risk of fire. Your municipal household hazardous waste (HHW) collection center may accept this recalled lithium-ion battery or device for disposal. Before taking your battery or device to a HHW collection center, contact that office ahead of time and ask whether it accepts recalled lithium-ion batteries. If it does not, contact your municipality for further guidance. Source: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2025/ESR-HaloLock-Wireless-Power-Banks-Recalled-Due-to-Fire-and-Burn-Hazards-Distributed-by-Waymeet

description: CT-ENERGY Lithium Coin Battery Chargers Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violations of Standard for Coin Battery Products and Statute for Battery Packaging; Imported by CT New Energy Technology
report_text: CPSC recall 25449 published 2025-08-28. Title: CT-ENERGY Lithium Coin Battery Chargers Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violations of Standard for Coin Battery Products and Statute for Battery Packaging; Imported by CT New Energy Technology Product: CT-ENERGY Lithium Coin Battery Chargers with Rechargeable 2032 Batteries Hazard: The recalled battery charger violates the mandatory standard for consumer products containing button cell or coin batteries because the charger has lithium coin batteries that can be accessed easily by children. In addition, the coin batteries provided with the battery charger are not in child-resistant packaging, and the packaging does not have the warnings as required by Reese's Law. When button cell or coin batteries are swallowed, the ingested batteries can cause serious injuries, internal chemical burns and death. Incidents/Injuries: None reported Remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the charger and remove the batteries and place them in an area that children cannot access. Contact CT New Energy Technology for a full refund, Child-Resistant Safety Case, or replacement kit. The complimentary repair kits and replacement kits will be available after August 30, 2025. Consumers will be asked to submit photos of the batteries' destruction completely submerged in tap water to info@ct-energy.cn. Soaking the batteries in water for 24 hours discharges the battery. Note: Button cell and coin batteries are hazardous. Batteries should be disposed of or recycled by following local hazardous waste procedures. Source: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2025/CT-ENERGY-Lithium-Coin-Battery-Chargers-Recalled-Due-to-Risk-of-Serious-Injury-or-Death-from-Battery-Ingestion-Violations-of-Standard-for-Coin-Battery-Products-and-Statute-for-Battery-Packaging-Imported-by-CT-New-Energy-Technology

name: Counterfeit LG-branded TM-510 Cell Phone Batteries
description: CPSC, Verizon Wireless Announce Recall of Counterfeit Cell Phone Batteries
report_text: CPSC recall 04559 published 2004-06-24. Title: CPSC, Verizon Wireless Announce Recall of Counterfeit Cell Phone Batteries Product: Counterfeit LG-branded TM-510 Cell Phone Batteries Hazard: Some LG-branded TM-510 batteries may be counterfeit and susceptible to overcharging, especially if used with a non-LG charger. LG Infocomm U.S.A. Inc. states that these are counterfeit LG-branded batteries, which do not contain a safety device in the circuitry, to prevent overcharging. In turn, the counterfeit batteries can overheat, posing a fire and burn hazard to users. Incidents/Injuries: Verizon Wireless has received 18 reports of incidents involving counterfeit batteries, including injuries to users and property damage. Remedy: Consumers with a LG TM510 cell phone battery having one of the identified manufacturer/date codes and purchased from Verizon Wireless should stop charging the battery immediately and contact Verizon Wireless to receive a replacement battery. Verizon Wireless is sending letters directly to consumers notifying them of this hazard. Source: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2004/CPSC-Verizon-Wireless-Announce-Recall-of-Counterfeit-Cell-Phone-Batteries

name: Targus Universal Wall Power Adapters for Laptops
description: Comarco Recalls Power Adapters for Laptops Due to Burn Hazard
report_text: CPSC recall 10214 published 2010-04-30. Title: Comarco Recalls Power Adapters for Laptops Due to Burn Hazard Product: Targus Universal Wall Power Adapters for Laptops Hazard: Faulty wiring can cause the connector tips to heat and melt the plastic encasing the connector tips, posing a burn hazard to consumers. report_text: CPSC recall 21078 published 2021-02-12. Remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled computer cases and contact NZXT for a free repair kit. Source: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2021/NZXT-Recalls-H1-Computer-Cases-Due-to-Fire-Hazard

Remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled batteries and contact Toshiba to receive a free replacement battery. Consumers should use only batteries obtained from Toshiba or from an authorized Toshiba reseller. If consumers are not contacted by Kyocera by Feb. 6, they are asked to contact the firm to receive the free replacement battery. report_text: CPSC recall 02037 published 2001-11-13. name: KTEBO Writing Tablet Toy
description: KTEBO Writing Tablet Toys Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violates Mandatory Standard for Toys; Sold on Amazon by KTEBO
report_text: CPSC recall 26131 published 2025-12-04. Incidents/Injuries: None reported Remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled writing tablet toys and contact KTEBO for a free replacement set of tablet toys. Consumers should write "RECALLED" on the back of both tablet toys that came in the set, take a photo of the marked tablet toys, and submit the photos to writing-tablet-recall@ktebo.com with "Recall Proof" and their name in the subject line. name: iStore Magnetic Wireless Power Banks (IST-09991/W05 model only)
description: iStore Magnetic Wireless Power Banks Recalled Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Imported by Tomauri
report_text: CPSC recall 25390 published 2025-07-17. Title: iStore Magnetic Wireless Power Banks Recalled Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Imported by Tomauri Product: iStore Magnetic Wireless Power Banks (IST-09991/W05 model only) Hazard: The lithium-ion battery in the recalled power banks can overheat and ignite while charging, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. The firm received reports of property damage of about $15,000. Consumers will be asked to submit two photographs via email to recall@istore.co. The first photograph should be the front of the power bank with the word "Recalled" and the date written on it with permanent marker. The second photograph should include the model number, which is located on the back of the power bank. A purchase receipt will be requested but will not be required to participate in the recall. Consumers should immediately dispose of the power banks in accordance with local and state hazardous waste disposal regulations. name: Mares Nemo Air Dive Computers
description: Dive Computers Recalled by Mares Due to Drowning Hazard
report_text: CPSC recall 10197 published 2010-04-14. Title: Dive Computers Recalled by Mares Due to Drowning Hazard Product: Mares Nemo Air Dive Computers Hazard: An O-ring in the high pressure air connector can fail and leak air, causing a continuous but slow loss of breathing gas, which could require a diver to surface quickly, posing a drowning hazard to divers. Incidents/Injuries: None reported. Remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled dive computer and connectors, and return the products to their authorized Mares dive shop for a free replacement O-ring connector assembly. The O-rings in some units may already have been replaced, but this recall requires replacing the metal quick connector fitting at the end of the high pressure air hose that holds the O-ring. Replacement connector assemblies have a groove machined around the middle of the fitting, but recalled units do not. All consumers should take their Nemo Air dive computers to a Mares dive shop to confirm whether this connector fitting has been replaced. Source: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2010/Dive-Computers-Recalled-by-Mares-Due-to-Drowning-Hazard

description: Sony Recalls Notebook Computer Batteries Due to Previous Fires
report_text: CPSC recall 07011 published 2006-10-23. All of these reported incidents and injuries have been associated with earlier recalls of notebook computer batteries containing these Sony cells. There have been no incidents involving batteries sold by the notebook manufacturers participating in this announcement. Remedy: Consumers should remove the affected batteries from notebook computers until they contact their computer manufacturer and receive further instructions. Batteries covered by this program will be replaced free of charge. Consumers should use only batteries obtained from their computer manufacturer or from an authorized reseller. inspection_agency: 国家市场监督管理总局缺陷产品召回技术中心
report_text: 中国缺陷产品召回公告 2025-03-28。 标题：广东康宝电器股份有限公司召回部分康宝牌嵌入式洗碗机 生产者：广东康宝电器股份有限公司 产品：嵌入式 洗碗机 品牌：康宝 型号规格：XWJ8-QC4 涉及数量：231 台 存在的缺陷：本批次部分呼吸器防虹吸吸气道焊接时，个别焊接熔胶掉入虹吸气道， 导致 防虹吸道进气量偏小，进水通道未达到完整防虹吸效果 ， 不符合 GB 4706.1-2005 、 GB 4706.25-2008 标准第 22.48 条的要求。 可能导致的后果：在外部供水系统完全停止供水状态下， 可能导致非饮用水进入水源， 存 在安 全隐患 。 召回措施：通知销售商停止销售缺陷产品，并在公司官网发布召回公告及通过销 售 商 销售店铺张贴召回公告，告知消费者具体召回事宜，为购买到缺 陷产 品的 消费者免费退货或免费维修处理。 来源：https://www.samrdprc.org.cn/xfpzh/xfpzhgg/202504/t20250403_113216.html

report_text: 中国缺陷产品召回公告 2024-10-16。 标题：常州洪都电动车有限公司召回部分凤凰牌电动自行车 生产者：常州洪都电动车有限公司 产品：电动自行车 品牌 凤凰牌 型号规格：TDT2121Z 存在的缺陷：1、整车质量大于55kg； 2、反射器、照明和鸣号装置（反射器、照明）：侧反射器、脚蹬 反射器光学要求不合格，后灯亮度不合格； 3、电气装置（短路保护），电池输出端中断路保护装置规格参数 不符合使用说明书明示的规定； 4、充电器与蓄电池（蓄电池防篡改），蓄电池与电池组盒侧壁最 大间隙大于30mm，有晃动。 可能导致的后果：1、由于整车质量大于55kg，超重使得惯性过大，影响操控和制动 性能，刹车距离增加，可能导致发生交通事故，造成或加重交通 参与者的人身伤害。 2、由于侧反射器、脚蹬反射器光学要求不合格，消费者在光照 不足的情况下骑行，不能被其他机动车辆有效辨别，可能导致交 通事故的后果。由于后灯亮度不合格，消费者夜晚骑行时，不易 观察清楚路面情况，或不能被其他机动车辆有效辨别，可能导致 交通事故，造成人员意外受伤的后果。 3、由于电气装置(短路保护) ，断路保护装置规格参数不符合使 用说明书明示的规定；可能导致当由于导线破损或电负荷过大等 原因导致电气线路产生异常电流时，局部导线积聚大量热量，造 成产品起火甚至导致火灾的后果。 4、由于充电器与蓄电池（蓄电池防篡改），蓄电池与电池组盒侧 壁最大间隙大于30mm，有晃动。为违规增设电池或改装电路提供 了可能，可能导致车辆超重或超速，造成起火以及发生交通事故 的后果。 召回措施：常州洪都电动车有限公司将在 厂门口和天津兴世达 经销商门店发 布召回信息，敬请消费者立即停止使用召回范围内的产品，并联 系经销商进行免费维修更换，以消除安全隐患。消费者因本次召 回所产生的邮寄等相关费用均由常州洪都电动车有限公司承担。 来源：https://www.samrdprc.org.cn/xfpzh/xfpzhgg/202410/t20241017_112115.html

report_text: 中国缺陷产品召回公告 2025-01-02。 标题：无锡上达嘉陵车业有限公司召回部分永久牌TDT1021Z型号电动自行车 生产者：无锡上达嘉陵车业有限公司 产品：电动自行车 品牌 永久 型号规格：TDT1021Z 存在的缺陷：1.整车质量大于55kg； 2.蓄电池与电池组盒未合理匹配，蓄电池与电池组盒壁的最大间隙为过大，且能 晃动； 3.车体宽度（除车把、脚蹬部分外）大于450mm 、鞍座长度大于350mm； 4.前灯后灯亮度值低。 可能导致的后果：1.整车质量过重会导致车辆运动惯性增大，影响操控和制动性能，刹车距离增加， 极易发生交通事故，带来安全隐患； 2.为违规对电动自行车电池进行扩容改装提供了可能，电池电压、容量增加，超 过原车设计数值，可能引起线路发热过载，引发起火爆炸等严重安全隐患； 3.车辆超宽，会挤占非机动车道的空间，易与其他非机动车以及行人发生擦碰。 鞍座尺寸过长，便于载人载货等超载行为，也存在一定安全隐患； 4.前灯亮度值低夜晚驾驶时驾驶人员看不清前方道路和物体，易造成交通事故； 后灯照明亮度值低，夜晚无法提醒后方车辆或行人，易造成追尾事故，存在安全 隐患。 召回措施：无锡上达嘉陵车业有限公司将在厂门口及经销商门店方式发布公告，以及通过微信 等方式，通知召回信息，敬请消费者立即停止使用召回范围内的产品，并联系生产 者、经销商免费更换全新的符合要求的电池组盒（座桶）、车把横管、鞍座、前 灯、后灯以及维修恢复原始配置（对电池进行检查并恢复出厂设置），以消除安全 隐患。消费者因本次召回所产生的邮寄等相关费用均由无锡上达嘉陵车业有限公司 公司承担。 来源：https://www.samrdprc.org.cn/xfpzh/xfpzhgg/202501/t20250103_112786.html

report_text: 中国缺陷产品召回公告 2024-10-31。 标题：无锡万源机车有限公司召回好耐奇牌、三田牌电动自行车 生产者：无锡万源机车有限公司 产品：电动自行车 品牌 1）好耐奇 2）三田牌 型号规格：1）TDT807Z；2）TDT6021Z 存在的缺陷：一、TDT807Z 好耐奇牌 电池输出端中断路器保护装置规格与使用说明书不一致。 二、TDT6021Z 三田牌 1.电池输出端中断路器保护装置规格与使用说明书不一致； 2.整车质量大于55kg； 3.整车垂直向一侧倾斜25°，脚蹬触及地面。 可能导致的后果：1.车辆实际熔断器规格与说明书不一致，会造成需要新更换的熔断器规格 不匹配，起不到应有的保护作用； 2.整车质量过重会导致车辆运动惯性增大，影响操控和制动性能，刹车距 离增加，易发生交通事故，带来安全隐患； 3.在骑行转弯过程中，脚蹬触及地面，容易造成交通事故，给自身和行人 造成伤害。 召回措施：无锡万源机车有限公司将通过厂门口及各经销商门店发布召回公告，敬请 消费者立即停止使用召回范围内的产品，并联系各经销商进行免费维修， 以消除安全隐患。消费者因本次召回所产生的邮寄等相关费用均由无锡万 源机车有限公 司承担。 维修方式如下： 1.TDT807Z 好耐奇牌：更换说明书； 2.TDT6021Z 三田牌：更换脚蹬曲柄、说明书、前轮。 来源：https://www.samrdprc.org.cn/xfpzh/xfpzhgg/202411/t20241101_112198.html

report_text: 中国缺陷产品召回公告 2024-10-15。 标题：小鸟车业有限公司召回部分小鸟牌电动自行车 生产者：小鸟车业有限公司 产品：电动自行车 品牌 小鸟 型号规格：1.TDT607Z、2.TDT653Z、3.TDT689Z、4.TDT683Z、5.TDT652Z、 6.TDT631Z 存在的缺陷：一、TDT607Z、TDT653Z 1、整车质量：整车质量超重； 2、控制系统（过流保护功能）：控制系统输入电流最大值与明示 值 不一致。 二、TDT689Z 1、控制系统（过流保护功能）：控制系统输入电流最大值24.5A， 与 明示值22±1A不一致； 2、充电器与蓄电池（蓄电池防篡改）：蓄电池与电池组侧壁的最 大间 隙为45mm，有晃动。 三、TDT683Z 1、整车质量：整车质量超重，达到56.9kg； 2、尺寸限值：轴距超长，达到1288mm； 3、控制系统（过流保护功能）：控制系统输入电流最大值24.3A， 与明 示值22±1A不一致。 四、TDT652Z、TDT631Z 1、整车质量：整车质量超重； 2、控制系统（过流保护功能）：控制系统输入电流最大值与明 示值不 一致。 可能导致的后果：1、整车质量过重，会导致车辆运动惯性增大，影响操控和制动 性能， 刹车距离增加，极易发生交通事故，带来安全隐患 ； 2、控制系统中过流保护值设置过高会导致车辆在超载或上坡时， 会因 电流过大引起元件起火； 3、蓄电池与电池组盒未合理匹配，或预留扩展车载蓄电池的接 口，则 存在被改装的风险，电池电压、容量增加，超过原车设计 数值，引起线 路发热过载，引发起火爆炸等严重安全隐患； 4、车辆超长、超宽，会挤占非机动车道的空间，易与其他非机 动车以 及行人发生擦碰。 召回措施：小鸟车业有限公司将将通过工厂门口及各销售门店发布召回信 息，敬 请 消费者立即停止使用召回范围内的产品，并联系经销 商进行免费维修 更 换，以消除安全隐患。消费者因本次召回所 产生的邮寄等相关费用均由 小鸟车业有限公司承担。 维修更换方式如下： 1、TDT607Z及TDT653Z更换全新的符合要求的后衣架、控制器， 拆除加装 的工具斗、后衣架塑件； 2、TDT689Z更换全新的符合要求的控制器、座桶； 3、TDT683Z更换全新的符合要求的后平叉、控制器，拆除加装 的电池盒； 4、TDT652Z及TDT631Z更换全新的符合要求的控制器、拆除加 装的电池盒。 来源：https://www.samrdprc.org.cn/xfpzh/xfpzhgg/202410/t20241017_112112.html
